✨ Quick Start — 4 Easy Steps

Follow the steps in order so the correct Master Template is always used.

🔒 Learner data stays on this browser
1

Download & Complete the Template

Download the built-in Master Template first. Replace the sample school and learner information with your own data, grades, class days, and attendance.

✓ Keep sheet names & headers unchanged
Start here before uploading.

Smart SF9 checks the uploaded workbook first. Review the detected learners, then load the workbook into your local workspace.

Upload a completed Excel file to continue.
